title: Subsets with Sum Divisible by D

monster.name: Divisor Golem
monster.title: Tallyman of Modular Partitions
monster.defeatQuote: Every subset with sum divisible by d accounted for!

description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `d`, return the number of non-empty subsets whose sum is divisible by `d`.
starterCode:
def subsetsSumDivD(nums: list[int], d: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def subsetsSumDivD(nums: list[int], d: int) -> int:
    count = 0
    def dfs(idx, curr_sum, picked):
        nonlocal count
        if idx == len(nums):
            if picked and curr_sum % d == 0: count += 1
            return
        dfs(idx + 1, curr_sum, picked)
        dfs(idx + 1, curr_sum + nums[idx], True)
    dfs(0, 0, False)
    return count
hints: Track running sum mod d and count when picked is True and sum % d == 0.
